units.title: Fix parse_orders bug
units.brief: The orders parser crashes on quantities like '12 units'. Fix parse_orders in code repo file orders.py so total() sums numeric parts only. Do not change total(). Hidden tests will verify.
units.background: CI is red; the fix should stay minimal.

config.hidden_tests:
import re
def _num(x): return int(re.sub(r'[^0-9]', '', x))
test_text = "sku,qty\nA1,\'12 units\'\nB2,7\nC3,\'5 units\'"
assert total(test_text) == 24, total(test_text)
test_text2 = "sku,qty\nX1,\'0 units\'\nY2,3"
assert total(test_text2) == 3, total(test_text2)
print('ALL_TESTS_PASSED')
